evd_title: ChatGPT achieved perfect agreement with human raters on 3 of 12 PRISMA checklist items for systematic reviews but significant discrepancy on eligibility criteria (p=0.028)
finding: ChatGPT achieved perfect agreement with human raters on 3 of 12 PRISMA checklist items for systematic reviews but significant discrepancy on eligibility criteria (p=0.028)
P: 20 systematic-review abstracts from 4 orthodontic journals (AJO-DO, JO, EJO, AO), 12-item PRISMA-for-abstracts
I: ChatGPT 3.5 (free chat UI), expert-impersonation system prompt + chain-of-thought, abstract pasted in
O: Per-item % reported, Fisher p: perfect agreement 3/12; significant difference only eligibility (90% vs 60%, p=0.028); 11/12 n.s.
T: Abstracts published 2018-2022; ChatGPT 3.5 accessed 30 May 2024; paper 2024
